# contract

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/resolution/domain/contract"
```

Package contract owns the proto projection for Domain — a one\-way mapping from the typed resolve.ResolvedDomainSpec to the canonical proto DomainSpec used for content\-addressable hashing, audit trails, and gRPC API responses.

One\-way contract:

```
resolve.ResolvedDomainSpec → networkscontractv1alpha1.DomainSpec
```

This projection is NEVER fed back into controllers. It is the canonical serialization of a resolved Domain intent — output only.

TLS strategy wrapper:

```
DomainSpec.TlsStrategy is *commonv1.DomainTLSStrategy — a common/v1 wrapper
message consistent with the RouteRuntime / RoutePhase wrapper pattern.

"platform" → DOMAIN_TLS_STRATEGY_PLATFORM
"custom"   → DOMAIN_TLS_STRATEGY_CUSTOM
nil / ""   → DOMAIN_TLS_STRATEGY_UNSPECIFIED  (safety fallback only —
             tlsStrategy is validated as mandatory in resolve)
```

See also:

- resolution/domain/resolve — resolution entry point and TLSStrategy type
- resolution/domain/adapter — interface wrapper
- blanketops/networks/v1alpha1/domain.proto
- blanketops/common/v1/domain.proto

## func ToDomainContract

```go
func ToDomainContract(d *resolve.ResolvedDomain) (*networkscontractv1alpha1.DomainSpec, error)
```

ToDomainContract projects a ResolvedDomain into the canonical proto DomainSpec for infrastructure consumers \(hashing, audit logging, gRPC serialization\). Returns nil, nil for nil input — callers decide whether that is an error.

⚠️ ONE\-WAY adapter. The returned value MUST NOT be fed back into any controller or domain logic path.
